title: Street-Style Plant-Based Mince Pita Pockets
subtitle: with Tomato and Mixed Salad
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced. Thinly slice the onion. Coarsely chop the tomato. Halve the pita to form 4 pockets, put in a single layer on an oven tray and cover with foil. Heat in the oven for 10 mins or until softened and warmed through.
Soften onion: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook half the onion (see Make it yours), stirring occasionally, for 3 mins or until softened.

Brown plant-based mince: Increase the heat to medium-high, add the plant-based mince to the pan and cook, breaking up the lumps with a spoon, for 5-6 mins until browned. Add the kofta seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Make salad: Put 1½ tbs olive oil, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and ½ tsp dijon mustard in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the tomato, salad leaves and remaining onion and toss to combine.
Serve up: Gently open the pita pockets, then spread with the vegan mayonnaise. Fill with the mince and salad and enjoy!
Make it yours: Not a fan of raw onion? Simply cook all the onion in Step 2 and omit it from the salad. ~ If you aren't following a vegan diet, use whatever mayonnaise you have on hand.
